## Summary

Describe the narrow change and the TrustPermit or contributor workflow it
supports.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] Additional focused check (describe below, if applicable)

## Safety and scope

- [ ] No secrets, wallets, credentials, or private infrastructure details are
      included.
- [ ] The change preserves deterministic SDK behavior and the existing program
      ID unless the PR explicitly updates every affected reference.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog impact has been considered.
